trophies.guide: The platinum pops the moment the other 54 are earned. Everything is single-player and offline — no online trophy and no DLC is needed — so the platinum is a matter of time, not skill: finish the five-chapter story, work the 100% checklist, then clean up the stranger strands and whatever is left.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
steps: Earn all 54 other trophies.
The platinum unlocks automatically once the last one pops.

trophies.guide: Complete the opening mission, Gone Fishing — Lucia and Jason's return to Leonida. It is the first story mission, and the trophy pops when the mission ends, so it cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
steps: Start a new game and play Gone Fishing to the end.
The trophy pops at the mission-complete screen.

trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 1. Play every story mission in order; the trophy pops when the chapter's final mission ends.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost
steps: Play the Chapter 1 story missions in order.
The trophy pops when the chapter's final mission ends.

trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 2. Play every story mission in order; the trophy pops when the chapter's final mission ends.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
steps: Play the Chapter 2 story missions in order.
The trophy pops when the chapter's final mission ends.

trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 3. Play every story mission in order; the trophy pops when the chapter's final mission ends.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
steps: Play the Chapter 3 story missions in order.
The trophy pops when the chapter's final mission ends.

trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 4. Play every story mission in order; the trophy pops when the chapter's final mission ends.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
steps: Play the Chapter 4 story missions in order.
The trophy pops when the chapter's final mission ends.

trophies.guide: Complete the final mission. Play the story through to the credits — the gold pops at the end of the last mission, and with the story done Stage 1 of the roadmap is finished.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
steps: Finish Chapters 1 to 4.
Play the final mission to the end; the gold pops at the credits.

trophies.guide: Complete the mission Breakfast Run. It is a story mission in Chapter 1 — play it through and the trophy pops at the mission-complete screen.
trophies.name: Trust
steps: Reach Breakfast Run in the story.
Complete the mission; the trophy pops at the end.

trophies.guide: Complete the mission The Cartel Heist. It is a story heist mission — play it through and the trophy pops at the mission-complete screen.
trophies.name: Break the Bank
steps: Reach The Cartel Heist in the story.
Complete the mission; the trophy pops at the end.

trophies.guide: Complete the mission Child's Play. It is a story mission — play it through and the trophy pops at the mission-complete screen.
trophies.name: Family Matters
steps: Reach Child's Play in the story.
Complete the mission; the trophy pops at the end.

trophies.guide: Complete the mission Headliners. It is a story mission — play it through and the trophy pops at the mission-complete screen.
trophies.name: DWNFALL
steps: Reach Headliners in the story.
Complete the mission; the trophy pops at the end.

trophies.guide: Complete the mission VCIA Takedown. It is a story mission at the airport — play it through and the trophy pops at the mission-complete screen.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
steps: Reach VCIA Takedown in the story.
Complete the mission; the trophy pops at the end.

trophies.guide: Complete the mission Operation Savage Glory. It is a story mission — play it through and the trophy pops at the mission-complete screen.
trophies.name: Snow Storm
steps: Reach Operation Savage Glory in the story.
Complete the mission; the trophy pops at the end.

trophies.guide: Attain 100% completion. The checklist is the story, the stranger strands, the collectibles and the activities — the roadmap's Stage 2 lists every item and its count, so work it in order and the gold pops at 100%.
trophies.name: A Long Road
steps: Finish the story (Stage 1).
Work the Stage 2 checklist: strands, collectibles, activities and world counts.
The gold pops the moment the counter hits 100%.

trophies.guide: Pull off 250 stunts — jumps, near-misses, airtime and drifts all count. Free-roam driving between missions is the fastest way to rack them up; each stunt shows a small on-screen tally, and the counter in this guide tracks your total.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
steps: Drive in free roam and chain jumps, near-misses and drifts.
Each stunt adds to the tally — 250 in total.
Use fast cars and open roads to keep the chain going.

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once — racing, fishing, the shooting range, drone races, arcade games, bowling and the rest. The activities list in the pause menu shows which types you have tried, so tick them off one by one.
trophies.name: Master of None
steps: Open the activities list and note the 9 types.
Try each type once — a single attempt counts.
The trophy pops when the ninth type is tried.

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Each range has several courses; learn the target order on a practice run, then go for gold — steady aim beats speed on the long targets, and the counter tracks how many are golded.
trophies.name: The Shootist
steps: Visit a shooting range and learn each course on a practice run.
Gold all 42 challenges — 42 in total.
Steady aim beats speed on the long targets.

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations. Each location has its own course — cut the corners tight, boost on the straights, and work through the location list one by one.
trophies.name: Top Fun
steps: Find a Top Fun drone race location.
Win the race at each of the 14 locations.
Cut corners tight and boost on the straights.

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — each race counts once, so work through the race list rather than repeating one. Street, off-road and boat races all count toward the 20.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
steps: Open the race list and pick a race you have not won.
Win 20 different races in total.
Street, off-road and boat races all count.

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Fish the challenge spot he suggests, keep the line tension in the green and reel steady — jerking the rod loses the fish, and Cal does not wait around.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
steps: Take Cal's fishing challenge.
Keep the line tension in the green and reel steady.
Land the fish to beat him.

trophies.guide: Complete an arcade game — any cabinet in any arcade. Play it to its end screen; a quick game counts the same as a long one, so pick the shortest cabinet you find.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
steps: Find an arcade cabinet.
Play the game to its end screen.
The trophy pops when the game ends.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Andy. Andy's strand is one of the stranger strands — meet him where his ? mark appears, take his missions and see the strand to its end.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
steps: Find Andy's ? mark and start his strand.
Play his missions in order.
The trophy pops at his final mission.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Kenton. Kenton's strand is one of the stranger strands — meet him where his ? mark appears, take his missions and see the strand to its end.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
steps: Find Kenton's ? mark and start his strand.
Play his missions in order.
The trophy pops at his final mission.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Billy. Billy's strand is one of the stranger strands — meet him where his ? mark appears, take his missions and see the strand to its end.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider
steps: Find Billy's ? mark and start his strand.
Play his missions in order.
The trophy pops at his final mission.

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida. Strangers appear as ? marks on the map — meet them, take their missions and see each strand to its end. Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone are five of the eight; the other three are out in the state.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
steps: Follow every ? mark on the map and start each stranger's strand.
Finish all 8 strands — Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone are five of them.
The silver pops when the eighth strand ends.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Randy. Randy's strand is one of the stranger strands — meet him where his ? mark appears, take his missions and see the strand to its end.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand
steps: Find Randy's ? mark and start his strand.
Play his missions in order.
The trophy pops at his final mission.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Tyrone. Tyrone's strand is one of the stranger strands — meet him where his ? mark appears, take his missions and see the strand to its end.
trophies.name: Spin On This!
steps: Find Tyrone's ? mark and start his strand.
Play his missions in order.
The trophy pops at his final mission.

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 spots across Leonida. This is the set's only missable trophy: some spots are only open while their chapter is live, so keep a manual save before you leave each chapter's area and log every credited spot as you go — the counter in this guide tracks your tally against 18.
trophies.missableNote: The only missable trophy in the set. Some meditation spots are only open while their chapter is live — once the story moves on, a missed spot may be gone for that playthrough. Keep a manual save per chapter and log every spot.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
steps: Keep a separate manual save before leaving each chapter's area. [1]
Meditate at every spot you find; the counter logs each credited spot.
Reconcile your total against 18 before moving on to the next chapter. [2]

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret's hunt sends you after one specific animal — follow his directions to the hunting ground, track it quietly and take it cleanly.
trophies.name: Fair Game
steps: Take Bret's hunt.
Follow his directions to the hunting ground.
Track the animal and take it cleanly.

trophies.guide: Complete 3 collectible card sets. Cards are hidden across Leonida — in shops, houses and out in the world. The checklist shows each set's progress; finish any three sets and the silver pops.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
steps: Collect cards across Leonida — shops, houses and the open world.
Complete any 3 full sets.
The silver pops when the third set is complete.

trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations — use the WAiNK app at photo spots across the map. The counter ticks each new location; work district by district so none is skipped, and the tally in this guide tracks your total.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
steps: Open the WAiNK app at a photo spot.
WAiNK It at 100 locations in total.
Work district by district so no spot is skipped.

trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges. Challenges are the small goals the game tracks — stunts, kills, driving feats and more. They stack up naturally while you play; check the challenge list to see which ones are close and chase those first.
trophies.name: One Last Thing
steps: Open the challenge list and note the closest ones.
Complete 50 challenges in total.
Stunts, kills and driving feats all feed the tally.

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star wanted level with your partner and escape. Get the heat up to four stars together, then break line of sight and stay out of the search cones until the stars clear — if your partner is caught, the attempt fails.
trophies.name: Hot Together
steps: Build a 4-star wanted level with your partner beside you. [1]
Break line of sight and stay out of the search cones.
The trophy pops once the stars clear with your partner free.
trophies.watch: Needs your partner beside you when the stars clear — if they are caught, the attempt fails and you start the heat again.

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your wanted level. Pick three shops close together, hit them in one run and keep the heat — if the stars clear between shops, the chain breaks and you start over.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy
steps: Pick three shops close together.
Rob them back-to-back with your partner, keeping your wanted level.
The trophy pops after the third shop if the heat never cleared.
trophies.watch: The chain breaks if your wanted level clears between shops — plan a tight route of three close shops.

trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles — every new vehicle you get into counts. Drive everything you see: cars, bikes, boats and planes all add to the tally, and the counter tracks your total toward 100.
trophies.name: Whip It Good
steps: Get into any vehicle you have not driven before.
Discover 100 vehicles in total.
Cars, bikes, boats and planes all count.

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Find a group of five, trigger Combat Focus and chain the shots — the slowdown makes the fifth shot as easy as the first, so pick a crowded spot.
trophies.name: Gunslinger
steps: Find a group of at least 5 enemies.
Trigger Combat Focus.
Down all 5 before the focus ends.

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA — the airport. Get to the airfield, grab a plane and take off without a flight plan. The trophy pops once you are airborne and clear of the runway.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
steps: Get to the VCIA airfield.
Take a plane and lift off without a flight plan.
The trophy pops once you are airborne and clear.
trophies.watch: Airport security will be on you fast — plan the route to a plane before you enter the airfield.

trophies.guide: Deal with the Rhinos — the tanks. Lure one into the open, hit it from behind or above where its armour is thin, and keep moving: a Rhino's cannon one-shots a car, so never sit still in its sights.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank
steps: Draw a Rhino into the open.
Hit it from behind or above, where its armour is thin.
Keep moving — its cannon one-shots a car.

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Go in quiet — no alarms, no witnesses, no cameras spotting you. If anyone raises the alarm, the trophy is lost for that run; leave and try again.
trophies.name: Sneakthief
steps: Pick a jewelry store and watch its patrols and cameras.
Get in and out with no alarm and no witness.
If anyone spots you, leave and retry — a detected run does not count.
trophies.watch: One alarm or one witness ends the attempt — scout the store first and go in quiet.

trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape. Each vault is a set-piece robbery — crack it, grab the cash and get clear before the response arrives. Five vaults, five clean getaways, and the silver pops after the fifth.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
steps: Crack a bank vault and grab the cash.
Escape before the response arrives.
Repeat for 5 vaults in total.
trophies.watch: The escape is part of the trophy — a vault cracked but no getaway does not count.

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Stop the truck, crack it open, take the cash and lose the heat — the trophy pops once you are clear of the wanted level.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
steps: Stop an armored truck.
Crack it open and take the cash.
Lose the heat — the trophy pops once you are clear.
trophies.watch: The getaway matters as much as the robbery — plan an escape route before you stop the truck.

trophies.guide: Explore all 52 areas of Leonida. The map fills in as you travel — drive every road, visit every town and the counter ticks each new area. The checklist shows which areas are still unvisited.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State
steps: Drive every road and visit every town.
Explore all 52 areas in total.
The map fills in as you travel — check it for gaps.

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation of each of the 9 gangs. Each gang runs its own rackets — hit one operation per gang and the trophy pops after the ninth. The counter tracks which gangs you have hit.
trophies.name: Pest Control
steps: Find an illegal operation run by a gang.
Rob one operation for each of the 9 gangs.
The trophy pops after the ninth gang.
trophies.watch: You need one operation per gang — hitting the same gang twice does not advance the count.

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Head to a bar on Ocean Drive, order a cocktail and take in the view — the trophy pops once the drink is served.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…
steps: Go to a bar on Ocean Drive.
Order a cocktail.
The trophy pops once the drink is served.

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. Drive a car through the showroom glass and out the other side — the bigger the entrance, the better, and the trophy pops once you are out.
trophies.name: Capital Offense
steps: Drive into a vehicle showroom.
Smash through the glass and out the other side.
The trophy pops once you are clear of the showroom.

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley. Bowl a full game and follow through on every frame — the trophy pops at the end of the game.
trophies.name: Let's Go Bowling
steps: Go to the Kolt & Associates bowling alley.
Bowl a full game, following through on every frame.
The trophy pops at the end of the game.

trophies.guide: A partnership moment with mass appeal — a story beat with Lucia and Jason. Play the story and it pops when the scene plays out; nothing special is needed beyond reaching that point.
trophies.name: Personal Best
steps: Play the story until the scene arrives.
The trophy pops when the scene plays out.

trophies.guide: Make choices — the game tracks them to 500. Every dialogue choice and story decision counts; play the story and the side content and the counter climbs toward 500 on its own.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
steps: Make dialogue choices and story decisions as you play.
The counter climbs toward 500.
The trophy pops at 500 choices.

trophies.guide: Succeed on a second try. Fail a mission or a challenge once, then pass it on the immediate retry — the trophy pops when the second attempt lands.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
steps: Fail a mission or challenge once.
Retry it right away and pass.
The trophy pops when the second attempt succeeds.

trophies.guide: Witness something strange. Leonida hides odd encounters — a strange light, an odd figure, a place that should not be there. Explore the map's edges and the trophy pops when you find one.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
steps: Explore the map's edges and odd corners.
Find a strange encounter — a light, a figure, a place that should not be there.
The trophy pops when you witness it.

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Knock someone down with a melee drive-by. Swing a melee weapon from a moving vehicle and connect — speed plus a clean hit is the whole trick, so line the target up early.
trophies.name: Ten Pin
steps: Get a melee weapon and a vehicle.
Drive past a target and swing as you pass.
The trophy pops on a clean hit.

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering marked bills through your contacts. Marked bills come from robberies — pass them to your contacts and the counter climbs toward $250,000. Robberies feed it, so it grows as you work the other trophies.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
steps: Rob for marked bills.
Pass them to your contacts to launder.
The trophy pops at $250,000 laundered.

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops — clothes, weapons, food and cars all count. Buy what you need as you play and the total adds up; big purchases like cars move it fastest.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
steps: Buy gear, clothes and cars across the shops.
Spend $100,000 in total.
Big purchases like cars move the total fastest.

trophies.guide: Purchase all 8 garage properties. Garages go on sale as you progress — check the property listings regularly and buy each one when it appears; the eighth purchase pops the trophy.
trophies.name: Little Boxes
steps: Check the property listings for garages.
Buy each garage as it goes on sale.
The trophy pops at the eighth garage.

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Open the app, register a vehicle you own, and repeat — any ten vehicles count, so register the ones already in your garages first.
trophies.name: On the Spot
steps: Open the Scooter Bros app.
Register a vehicle you own.
Repeat for 10 vehicles in total.
